name: Sotsugyou Ryokou
source:
A guy went on a graduation trip to a ski resort with three of his friends. Once there, he has four quick days to chase after 7 girls and 1 guy. 

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160404053637/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-a.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
一名男子与三位朋友前往滑雪度假村参加毕业旅行。抵达后，他只有短短四天，可以追求7名女孩和1名男孩。

[引自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160404053637/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-a.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
